texts: One related story in the Zone 1 Lead Article Card’s Related list (production .feature-primary ul.primary-related li): a bullet, then the title with its time inline right after it. Matches production on the 4 / 8 grid. No variants and no breakpoints (production is the same at every width).
Game Day: Turning LeBron James’ record numbers into words 56 mins ago

Matches production on the 4 / 8 grid (CLAUDE.md). CSS .feature-primary .primary-related: identical on the review sites checked (only the title family changes by theme); measured on ocregister.com at 360, 778, 900, 1100 and 1280px, the same at every width, so no breakpoints.
Bullet column 16px (spacing/200; production’s 1rem list indent), 4px color/gray/black dot 4px (spacing/050) from the top. Production: the browser’s disc marker, about 3.3px, black.
Headline and Time: one text layer. Title font/theme/heading-family Bold 12 (font/size/12), 19px line height, −1%, color/gray/black, 21:1 on white (production 12.25px, CSS weight 600 renders Bold, #000).
Time inline after the title: Noto Sans Regular 11 (font/size/11), 20.625px line height, color/gray/200, 6.6:1 (production #5D5B5A).
Height hugs the text. Spacing between items belongs to the list: 4px (spacing/050; production 4.375px).
Production only: the title turns --primary on hover (no hover state in Figma).

variants.description: Standard Zone 1 lead for a photo gallery story: the image is replaced by the Zone 1 Slideshow (production article.slideshow.feature-large). Mobile (below 640px): one column; headline, excerpt, Related list, then the slideshow full width (as production, checked 2026-10-26), then the 1px bottom rule. Layout follows the lead's width, not the screen: two columns when the lead is about 700px wide or more, one column when narrower (headline, excerpt, Related or byline, then the slideshow full width). On the homepage the third page column makes the lead narrow, so it is one column from 800 to 1279px (e.g. 594 wide at 1024) and below 640px, and two columns from 640 to 799px and from 1280px up.

texts: Component set · Variant: Style = Standard × Device = Desktop, Tablet, Mobile × Gallery = Image, Slideshow. Badge defaults to None. Gallery (2026-10-26, Karl): when the lead is a photo gallery, production swaps the image for an inline slideshow (article.slideshow.feature-large, seen on develop.denverpost.com), so Gallery=Slideshow uses the Zone 1 Slideshow component; the Gallery Icon Badge is not used on Zone 1. The For You tab featured story is its own component now: Blocks Lead Article Card (Blocks section, 2026-10-28).

One column (lead narrower than about 700px): homepage at 1024, lead 594 wide, Style=Standard, Gallery=Slideshow (layout only: built from the Mobile variant, so the headline shows at the Mobile size; at 1024 it is 29/33)
Man charged with murder after fatal attack on bicycling doctor in Dana Point
Vanroy Evan Smith, 39, of Long Beach is being held on $1 million bail.

Los Angeles Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert, right, sits on the ground after being sacked and losing the ball on the last play of the game as members of the Denver Broncos celebrate during the second half of an NFL football game.

Gallery (2026-10-26, Karl): Gallery=Image (default) or Gallery=Slideshow. A gallery lead swaps the image for Zone 1 Slideshow, as production does (article.slideshow.feature-large); Zone 1 has no Gallery Icon Badge.
Layout follows the lead's width, not the screen: two columns when the lead is about 700px wide or more (Desktop: slideshow 356, text 295, the rest of the 706 card between them, like production; Tablet: the slideshow fills the 358 column), one column when narrower (headline, excerpt, the Related list, then the slideshow full width).
On the homepage the third page column narrows the lead, so it is one column from 800 to 1279px (594 wide at 1024; sample at left) and below 640px, and two columns from 640 to 799px and from 1280px up (production, develop.denverpost.com, 2026-10-26). Controls switch at 800px (see Zone 1 Slideshow).
The For You featured story moved to its own component, Blocks Lead Article Card (2026-10-28).
Known issue: on Tablet, Gallery=Image, the image (391px) is wider than its 358px column.

Matches production on the 4 / 8 grid with spacing tokens (2026-11-02).

Matches production on the 4 / 8 grid: the Zone 1 CSS (section.feature-primary.busy, .feature-wrapper, .feature-left, .headline-list, .sidebar-ad-container) is identical on all 6 review sites; measured at 360, 778, 900, 1100, 1280 and 1728px, 2026-11-02. Production's 20.16px gaps are 20 (spacing/250).
Lead Column: Zone 1 Lead Article Card, 20px (spacing/250), then the 4 TopZone Article Cards (Device matching the block), 16px (spacing/200) between rows; 2 per row, 20px (spacing/250) apart, in S, M and XL; one column in XS and L.

M (800–1039px), built 989: Feature Wrapper 689 (Lead Column 405 = 60% − 8, 20px, Latest Headlines 264 = 40% − 12) and the ad column 300 with no gap (as production).
L (1040–1279px), built 1065: Feature Wrapper 731 (69.2% − 6: Lead Column 500, 20px, Latest Headlines 211), 20px, ad column 314 (30.8% − 14). 32px (spacing/400) below.
XL (≥1280px), built 1260: Feature Wrapper 940 (75% − 5: Lead Column 700, 20px, Latest Headlines 220), 20px, ad column 300 (25% − 15). 32px (spacing/400) below.
